description:
[Game reference] Food spoil times, fridges, and composting fertilizer per item. `spoil`: every food that spoils (`item`, `hours` of normal storage, `becomes` = the spoiled item). `spoil_rules`:
powered fridge / vending machine multipliers (0 = paused), the arctic biome (0), stack-merge limits. `compost`: every
item a composter takes (`item`, `fertilizer` produced per item - fractions are rounded up at random) and
`compost_rules` (`cycle_s` per item per stack, `slots`). Names come with each row. Use item=<shortname> for one food. A powered fridge stops spoiling. Link https://rust.wiki/spoilage.

item.description: One item's spoil time and compost value (shortname).

name: get_spoilage
